wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
MONEY COLLECT FEATURE
 This is the MONEY SYMBOL. It appears on reels 3, 4, and 5.
 At every spin, all MONEY SYMBOLS take a random value from a predefined set.
 Whenever WILD symbols hit on reels 1 and 2 alongside adjacent on reels 3,4 or 5,
 forming on a left-to-right pay way, the values of all are collected.
 The possible values for the MONEY SYMBOL are:
 Direct money award 1x, 2x, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 8X, 10X, 15X or 25X total bet.
 Jackpot value of Mini , Major or Mega. Mini jackpot value is 50x total bet. Major
 Jackpot value is 100x total bet. Mega Jackpot value is 500x total bet.
 Multipliers of 2x, 3x or 5x that apply to the total win of the collect feature.
 Multipliers and Jackpot values appear only on reel 5.

modes.name: Free Spins
modes.effects:
FEATURE
 Hit WILD SYMBOLS on reels 1 and 2 and BONUS on reel 3 to trigger the FREE SPINS FEATURE.
 10 free spins are awarded.
 The MONEY COLLECT FEATURE is active during free spins. During the round more and
 more are present on the reel strips.
Hit WILD SYMBOLS on reels 1 and 2 and BONUS on reel 3 during the round to add 10 more free spins. No limits!
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
The player has the options to increase the bet multiplier by 20%, to 30x bet per line. When playing with
 ante bet activated, the chance for two WILD symbols to hit on reels 1 and 2 increases, thus increasing also
 the chance for COLLECT and FREE SPINS features to hit
